hebrewText: הֱוֵי דָן אֶת כָּל הָאָדָם לְכַף זְכוּת
transliteration: Hevei dan et kol ha'adam l'chaf zechut

hebrewText: הֱוֵי מִתַּלְמִידָיו שֶׁל אַהֲרֹן אוֹהֵב שָׁלוֹם וְרוֹדֵף שָׁלוֹם אוֹהֵב אֶת הַבְּרִיּוֹת וּמְקָרְבָן לַתּוֹרָה
transliteration: Hevei mitalmidav shel Aharon, ohev shalom v'rodef shalom, ohev et hab'riyot um'karvan laTorah
translation: Be of the disciples of Aharon — loving peace, pursuing peace, loving people, and bringing them close to Torah.
Beloved is a person, for they were created in the Divine image.
Beloved is Israel, for they are called children of the Omnipresent.

hebrewText: עַל שְׁלֹשָׁה דְבָרִים הָעוֹלָם קַיָּם עַל הַדִּין וְעַל הָאֱמֶת וְעַל הַשָּׁלוֹם
transliteration: Al shlosha d'varim ha'olam kayam: al hadin, v'al ha'emet, v'al hashalom
translation: The world endures on three things: justice, truth, and peace.

hebrewText: מַה דְּעָלָךְ סְנֵי לְחַבְרָךְ לָא תַּעְבֵּיד
transliteration: Ma d'alach s'nei, l'chavrach lo ta'avid
translation: What is hateful to you, do not do to your fellow.

hebrewText: כָּל הַמְקַיֵּם נֶפֶשׁ אַחַת מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל כְּאִלּוּ קִיֵּם עוֹלָם מָלֵא
transliteration: Kol ham'kayem nefesh achat miYisrael, k'ilu kiyem olam malei
translation: Whoever sustains one soul, it is as if they sustained an entire world.
This too is for the good.

hebrewText: יָפָה שָׁעָה אַחַת בִּתְשׁוּבָה וּמַעֲשִׂים טוֹבִים בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה מִכָּל חַיֵּי הָעוֹלָם הַבָּא
transliteration: Yafa sha'ah achat bit'shuva u'ma'asim tovim ba'olam hazeh, mikol chayei ha'olam haba
translation: Better one hour of repentance and good deeds in this world than all the life of the World to Come.

hebrewText: כָּל הָעוֹסֵק בַּתּוֹרָה לִשְׁמָהּ זוֹכֶה לִדְבָרִים הַרְבֵּה
transliteration: Kol ha'osek baTorah lishmah, zocheh lid'varim harbeh
translation: Whoever engages in Torah for its own sake merits many things.

hebrewText: הֱוֵי עַז כַּנָּמֵר וְקַל כַּנֶּשֶׁר רָץ כַּצְּבִי וְגִבּוֹר כָּאֲרִי לַעֲשׂוֹת רְצוֹן אָבִיךָ שֶׁבַּשָּׁמָיִם
transliteration: Hevei az kanamer, v'kal kanesher, ratz katzvi, v'gibor ka'ari, la'asot r'tzon avicha shebashamayim
translation: Be bold as a leopard, light as an eagle, swift as a deer, and strong as a lion to do the will of your Father in Heaven.
